name: cohorts-losses-no-hire
about: Q-AD34: a mature cohort with no hire and losses after conversion, beside young ones; the brief must not invent a qualified count.

output.headline: November 3, 2026: Regional Class A — Joliet ran as the sole campaign, delivering 7 leads at $30.64 each from $214.50 spent.
points: Regional Class A — Joliet was the only campaign running on November 3, 2026: $214.50 spent, 10,230 impressions, 152 clicks, a 1.5% click rate, and 7 leads at $30.64 cost per lead.
November 2026 is 27 days in with spend so far sitting at $214.50 on Meta.
The 2026-10-05 cohort (19 leads, mature) shows 15 contacted, 5 converted, 3 applied, and 4 lost after conversion. None were qualified, closed as not qualified, hired, or closed before applying.
The 2026-10-19 cohort has 23 leads and is too young to judge: 17 contacted, 6 converted, 2 applied, 1 lost after conversion, none closed in either direction.
The 2026-11-02 cohort has 7 leads — matching today's haul — and is too young to judge: 3 contacted, none yet converted, applied, or closed.
